page.overview:
Who is Arnet?

Arnet was a human male who was a veteran Imperial AT-ST pilot and lieutenant. He piloted the Walker Blizzard Scout 1 during the Battle of Hoth, and later Tempest Scout 1 in Battle of Endor.

Arnet was a male Human veteran AT-ST pilot, who commanded the Imperial walker Blizzard Scout 1 in General Veers' Blizzard Force during the Battle of Hoth in the year 3 ABY.. Ultimately, the battle would end in a tactical victory, though strategic failure for the Imperials.

Earning the rank of lieutenant, Arnet piloted the enclosed AT-ST walker Tempest Scout 1. After the ambush of the Endor shield generator bunker, which was protecting the under construction Imperial battlestation, the Death Star II, Tempest Scout 1 was present near the bunker. Arnet was assigned to coordinate the surprise counterattack in the Battle of Endor. However, the battle would become a victory for the Alliance.

As an AT-ST driver, Arnet wore a gray jumpsuit, and a dark green and black helmet with a chinstrap and goggles.
